visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera follows a Corgi dog from a low angle as it walks through tall, green grass in a vast open field. The dog's fluffy rear and short legs are the focal point. In the distance, several large trees and power lines are visible under a grey, overcast sky. (2) The scene cuts to a young man kneeling in the grass wearing a black tank top and light-colored trousers with a butterfly tattoo on his right forearm. A Corgi with a pink collar stands in front of him, looking up expectantly. (3) The man holds a lime green tennis ball and moves it around playfully. The Corgi jumps up with its mouth open, trying to catch the ball. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the textures of the dog's fur and the blades of grass. (4) A close-up shows the Corgi successfully holding the tennis ball in its mouth while the man gently strokes its head. The man's hands are clearly visible and his facial expression is one of happy engagement. (5) In a final wide shot, the man throws the ball across the field. The two Corgis immediately turn and sprint through the grass, chasing after the ball toward a background of tall palm trees.

(3) The male speaker continues his vocal interaction, laughing softly and giving commands. The sound of dog panting and more rustling grass indicates physical activity. (4) The vocal energy remains positive and high as the man interacts closely with the dogs. Acoustic texture remains natural with clear articulation of speech. (5) A final sequence of rapid, rhythmic footsteps on grass sounds as the dogs run away, followed by the fading sounds of vocal encouragement and quiet outdoor ambience.
